milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The cyan concrete powder pillars are at spawn-relative x=±2, y=1-2, z=3-4. Target is the corridor center at that section (0,1,4). max_distance=3 ensures the player must walk forward from spawn (spawn-to-target distance is 4, so player must advance at least 1 block into the corridor). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking generally toward the blocks.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The magenta concrete pillars are at spawn-relative x=±2, y=1-2, z=9-10. Target is the corridor center at that section (0,1,10). max_distance=5 ensures the player is in the correct middle section of the corridor. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking generally toward the magenta blocks.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The black glazed terracotta pillars are at spawn-relative x=±2, y=1-2, z=15-16. Target is the corridor center at that section (0,1,16). max_distance=5 ensures the player has traversed the entire corridor to the far end. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking generally toward the black glazed terracotta blocks.
